reply.summary:
Implemented tasks 11–20. Backend typecheck and eslint on backend/src pass. I did not run the frontend typecheck or the full verification chain (build, root `npm run typecheck`/`lint`). I ran `npm install` locally to check, and did not touch package-lock.json.
- backend/src/auth.ts: added POST /password-reset (always 202 with the spec message; for a registered email it stores the SHA-256 of a 32-byte hex token and logs `Password reset code for <email>: <token>`). Added POST /password-reset/confirm (400 `Enter a new password.` first, then hash the password, consume the token hash, 400 with the invalid-code message if no row was consumed, otherwise update the password hash and return 204).
- backend/src/routes/notes.ts (new): `countTasks`, `toSummary`, `toNote`, and GET /, POST /, GET /:id and PATCH /:id, all scoped by `currentUser(req).id`, with the specified validation and 404/400 messages.
- backend/src/app.ts (new): `createApp(db)` with a 1mb JSON limit, /api/health, /api/auth, /api/notes behind `requireUser`, and the sanitized four-parameter error handler.
- backend/src/index.ts: now uses `openDatabase`, `createApp` and `config`, and keeps the listening log line.
- frontend/package.json: added the five Tiptap packages at ^3.0.0.

I wrote PATCH's two 400 messages myself, since the spec doesn't give them: `The note title must be text.` and `The note body must be a document.`

grep -c "password-reset" backend/src/auth.ts; file backend/src/auth.ts; git status --short | head
